void swap(int i, int j) {
    ll aux = comb[i][j];

void compute_comb() {
    int i, j;

    for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        comb[i][0] = 1;
        for (j = 1; j <= i; j++)

        swap(i, j);

ll get_difs(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {

ll get_coef(int conf) {
